## `@ix-xs/djs-bot`

The framework itself.

```ts
import { /* ... */ } from "@ix-xs/djs-bot";
```

### Functions

| Export | What it is | Documented in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `anyOf()` | Passes when **at least one** of the given guards passes. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `botHasPermission()` | Requires the *bot* to have all of the given permissions **in the current channel** (channel overwrites included, as computed by Discord). | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `buildCommandTree()` | Builds the full desired command tree (ignoring per-command scoping). | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `clearCommands()` | Removes **all** of the app's commands from one scope (a guild, or global). | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `commandsEqual()` | Whether a local command and the one Discord returned describe the same thing. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `commandToJSON()` | Converts one slash command definition to the REST JSON body Discord expects. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `computeIntents()` | Derives the minimal set of intents and partials for the given events. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `confirm()` | Shows a yes/no dialog and resolves to the user's choice (or `false` on timeout). | [UI](/api/ui/) |
| `cooldown()` | Per-invocation cooldown. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `createAuditLog()` | Creates an `AuditLog`. | [Audit](/api/audit/) |
| `createCache()` | Creates a `TTLCache`. | [Cache](/api/cache/) |
| `createCircuitBreaker()` | Creates a `CircuitBreaker`. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `createFeatureFlags()` | Creates a `FeatureFlags` service. | [Feature flags](/api/flags/) |
| `createI18n()` | Creates a translator. | [i18n](/api/i18n/) |
| `createLogger()` | Creates a root `Logger`. | [Logger](/api/logger/) |
| `createRateLimiter()` | Creates a `RateLimiter`. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `createStore()` | Builds a full `KVStore` from a minimal `KVBackend`. | [Store](/api/store/) |
| `customIdKey()` | Extracts just the routing key from a raw customId without decoding params. | [Options, params and fields](/api/options/) |
| `decodeCustomId()` | Decodes a customId back into its routing key and typed params. | [Options, params and fields](/api/options/) |
| `defineBot()` | Creates a `Bot`. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `defineButton()` | Defines a button. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineChannelSelect()` | Defines a native channel select menu. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineCommand()` | Defines a slash command with typed options, or with subcommands/groups. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineEvent()` | Defines a gateway event listener. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineFeature()` | Bundles a set of definitions into a reusable, publishable feature. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineJob()` | Defines a scheduled job. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineMentionableSelect()` | Defines a native mentionable (users + roles) select menu. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineMessageCommand()` | Defines a message context-menu command. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineModal()` | Defines a modal. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `definePlugin()` | Defines a cross-cutting plugin (hooks, middleware, capabilities). | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineRoleSelect()` | Defines a native role select menu. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineSelectMenu()` | Defines a string select menu (a custom list of options). | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineService()` | Defines an injectable service with explicit dependencies. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineStore()` | Wraps a `KVStore` as a service definition so it's injectable as `ctx.services.<token>` and discovered from a `*.service.ts` file. | [Store](/api/store/) |
| `defineTrigger()` | Defines a message trigger - an auto-responder that fires on `messageCreate`. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineUserCommand()` | Defines a user context-menu command. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `defineUserSelect()` | Defines a native user select menu. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `deployCommands()` | Deploys commands, honouring per-command scoping: - commands with no `guilds` go **global**, - commands with `guilds` go to **those guilds**. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `describeInteraction()` | Summarises an interaction as a kind plus a readable name - what a logging or metrics plugin wants to tag its records with. | [Context](/api/context/) |
| `dmOnly()` | Requires the interaction to happen in DMs. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `encodeCustomId()` | Encodes a routing key and typed params into a Discord-safe customId. | [Options, params and fields](/api/options/) |
| `env()` | Reads an environment variable (also consulting a `.env` file), with an optional fallback. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `fail()` | Signals a guard failed, with a user-facing reason. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `featureEnabled()` | A guard that blocks a command/component when a feature flag is off for the guild. | [Feature flags](/api/flags/) |
| `guard()` | Creates a named guard. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `guildOwnerOnly()` | Restricts usage to the owner of the server the interaction happens in. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `hasPermission()` | Requires the invoking member to have all of the given permissions **in the current channel** (channel overwrites included, as computed by Discord). | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `hasRole()` | Requires the invoking member to hold **at least one** of the given roles. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `inChannel()` | Restricts usage to specific channel ids. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `inGuild()` | Requires the interaction to happen inside a guild. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `isBot()` | Robust, cross-realm check that a value is a `Bot` - use this instead of `instanceof`, which breaks across the CJS/ESM dual-package boundary. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `isBotError()` | Type guard for `BotError`. | [Errors](/api/errors/) |
| `isHiddenChannel()` | Whether a channel is one the bot cannot view, sent by Discord with its name and details withheld ("obfuscated"). | [Cache](/api/cache/) |
| `isShardChild()` | True when the current process is a shard child spawned by a manager (so it should run the bot), rather than the manager itself. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `launchShardManager()` | Launches a `ShardingManager` for the given entry file. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `loadEnvFile()` | Loads a `.env` file into `process.env` (without overwriting existing vars). | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `loggerAuditSink()` | A sink that writes each entry to the structured logger. | [Audit](/api/audit/) |
| `memoryAuditSink()` | An in-memory sink (bounded ring buffer). | [Audit](/api/audit/) |
| `memoryStore()` | Creates an in-memory `KVStore` (fast, non-durable). | [Store](/api/store/) |
| `normalizeSharding()` | Normalises the loose `sharding` config into full options. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `not()` | Inverts a guard: passes when it fails. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `oneOf()` | Builds a codec for a parameter that must be one of a fixed set of strings, so `ctx.params` is typed as that union instead of a plain `string`. | [Options, params and fields](/api/options/) |
| `ownerOnly()` | Restricts usage to specific user ids. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `paginate()` | Sends a paginated message with prev/next (and first/last) controls, updating in place as the user navigates and disabling the controls on timeout. | [UI](/api/ui/) |
| `parseSchedule()` | Parses a duration, a cron expression or a macro into a schedule descriptor. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `pass()` | Signals a guard passed. | [Guards](/api/guards/) |
| `planDeployment()` | Partitions the registry's commands into a global set and per-guild sets based on each command's `guilds` field. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `rateLimit()` | A guard that allows `limit` uses per `window`, per scope (default `"user"`). | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `retry()` | Retries an async function with exponential backoff + jitter. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `sqliteStore()` | Creates a durable `KVStore` backed by SQLite (via node-comfort's built-in `node:sqlite`). | [Store](/api/store/) |
| `startHealthServer()` | Starts the health server. | [Health](/api/health/) |
| `storeAuditSink()` | A sink that persists entries in a `KVStore` (one key per entry). | [Audit](/api/audit/) |
| `subcommand()` | Defines one subcommand with its own typed options. | [Definitions](/api/definitions/) |
| `timeout()` | Rejects if `promise` doesn't settle within `ms`. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `timestamp()` | Renders a Discord timestamp (auto-localised in each user's client). | [Formatting](/api/formatting/) |
| `toAutocompleteChoices()` | Turns what an autocomplete handler returned into suggestions Discord accepts. | [Context](/api/context/) |
| `toPrometheus()` | Renders a status as the Prometheus text exposition format, so the endpoint can be scraped directly without an exporter. | [Health](/api/health/) |

### Classes

| Export | What it is | Documented in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Bot` | The bot application. | [Configuration](/api/configuration/) |
| `BotError` | A framework error with a stable code, an actionable hint, and a docs link. | [Errors](/api/errors/) |
| `CircuitBreaker` | A circuit breaker: after too many failures it "opens" and fails fast for a cool-off period, then tries again ("half-open") before fully recovering. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `CircuitOpenError` | Error thrown when calls are rejected because the circuit is open. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `Container` | Resolves service definitions and holds their singleton instances. | [Services](/api/services/) |
| `Logger` | Structured logger with level filtering and child bindings. | [Logger](/api/logger/) |
| `RateLimiter` | A fixed-window rate limiter, keyed by an arbitrary string. | [Resilience](/api/resilience/) |
| `Registry` | Holds every definition and exposes typed lookups. | [API overview](/api/overview/) |
| `TTLCache` | An in-memory TTL + LRU cache with single-flight fetching. | [Cache](/api/cache/) |

### Re-exported from discord.js

For convenience, so that a bot rarely needs to import from `discord.js` directly:

`ActionRowBuilder`, `ActivityType`, `AttachmentBuilder`, `ButtonStyle`, `ChannelType`, `Collection`, `Colors`, `EmbedBuilder`, `Events`, `GatewayIntentBits`, `MessageFlags`, `Partials`, `PermissionFlagsBits`, `TextInputStyle`, `TimestampStyles`.

## `@ix-xs/djs-bot/plugins`

The official plugins.

```ts
import { /* ... */ } from "@ix-xs/djs-bot/plugins";
```

### Functions
